about: Spec §8.11 'Links and mounts' (plan 7C Decision 20, Task 13), run by tests/escape_common.rs on the fixture of server_data.json. A hard link or a rename never brings a file from a read root, server data or an unlisted folder into a write root. A symbolic link is only a name: the fixture plants links from each write root to a denied file, and reading through one is denied at its target. 'mounts' cases (Linux) run with the launcher's socket namespace on and need a host with unprivileged user namespaces; elsewhere they are skipped with the launcher's reason. Their control runs only as root (an unprivileged process cannot clone mounts either), as in tests/namespace_linux.rs. Windows junctions are left to a person (plan 7C Decision 27).
